title: Build the VM core for WASM
lead: Compile the VM core and arena to WASM so the browser can run matches with the identical core (C22).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the web viewer UI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Milestone 7. The stack recommendation chose Rust partly because it compiles to WASM, letting the web viewer run live matches with the identical core. If C22 changes to all-TypeScript, this slice is replaced or dropped in the decisions slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- A WASM binding package over the pure core, its build script, and tests.
- `AGENTS.md`: the WASM build command.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - A match run through the WASM build (imp vs dwarf, seed 1) gives the same result and replay hash as the native build.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Get owner approval for the WASM toolchain (wasm-pack or equivalent) with reason and license before installing (C13).
- Keep the binding thin; no logic outside the pure core.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The native and WASM result and hash comparison passes.
- The WASM build command in AGENTS.md runs as written.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-wasm` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
